Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as molecule_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records to docs on doc_id, and LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142978'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending. Return all rows.
